text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Paging: route=redwood-api-canary p99=3.2s (>2.5s SLO) p95=1.1s. Error rate normal. Streaming stalls observed. Trigger: p99 breach 3 consecutive mins. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/internal/d/abcd/canary-overview?org=redwood

Devon: ack paging, I'm oncall. Pulling traces and LB metrics.

Ingrid: FYI I rolled m12 to canary (~10% traffic) at 04:05 UTC earlier. Warmup job kicked but might not have completed for all shards.

Mike: grabbing logs now, seeing tail latency on canary nodes. snippet from node logs:
```
[canary-srv-02] 2026-03-14T04:12:03Z tail latency > 2.8s on op=kv_load (stream attach)
p95 1.05s p99 3.2s
```

Devon: traces show lots of KV cold misses and long kv_load on the streaming attach path. Also LB weight reports show canary endpoints receiving ~23% due to health reroute while original pools draining — traffic skewed.

Ingrid: hmm, m12 changed the KV key layout for prefixing; warmup probably didn't cover the new keyspace. If true, rollback will remove the regressions fastest.

Mike: Agreed. Mitigation plan: (1) set canary weight -> 0 to stop new traffic, (2) rollback canary to m11, (3) monitor p95/p99 and streaming stall alerts. Commands: 
```
ci-deploy set-weight --route redwood-api-canary --percent 0
ci-deploy rollback --env=canary --from=m12 --to=m11
```

Devon: handing exec to @Mike for the rollback. I'll stay on to watch dashboards.

Mike: executing set-weight...
CI-Deploy: Initiating: set-weight redwood-api-canary -> 0% (user=Mike)
CI-Deploy: set-weight complete (duration=18s) :thumbsup:

Mike: starting rollback...
CI-Deploy: rollback job queued (id=rb-198234)
CI-Deploy: rollback in progress: migrating canary nodes to m11
CI-Deploy: rollback finished successfully (duration=42s)

CI-Deploy: Health checks: passing on all canary hosts. Instances draining: 0 active streams left.

Mike: verifying latency now.

Tara: I'll draft a short customer note. Rafael — can you check if any enterprise customers saw visible impact?

Rafael: scanning logs for high-value tenants... I see a few p99 / slow-response hits from "AstraHealth" between 04:10-04:16 UTC. No 5xxs, just high latency. I pinged their on-call via PagerDuty; they acknowledged and asked for ETA.

Devon: latest metrics (rolling 5m window) after rollback:
```
p95: 0.98s
p99: 1.35s
streaming-stalls: 0 in last 10m
```

incident-bot: RESOLVED: p99 back below threshold for 5 consecutive minutes. Incident severity downgraded.

Mike: preliminary root-cause: m12 introduced a change to KV prefixing that vastly increased cold cache working set for streaming attach, causing higher tail latency under canary traffic. Also LB smoothing allowed canary weight to spike during transient failures which amplified exposure.

Ingrid: follow-ups I'm taking: 1) revert KV layout change in m12 branch and open PR for cleaner migration, 2) add a canary warmup job that verifies KV access patterns for new models, 3) add LB skew detection alert (auto-smoothing) to prevent >5% deviation from configured weight.

Tara: customer comms: I'll send a concise note: what happened, who's affected (no errors, just slower responses), actions taken (rollback + mitigations), and ETA for full postmortem.

Devon: handoff: I'm passing primary to Mike for the postmortem and action tracking. I'll stay as secondary for 15m then sign off.

Mike: ack, taking ownership. Thanks everyone for quick responses. :heart: :rocket:

Devon: closing thread in 30m once action items are captured in the incident tracker.

Ingrid: adding follow-up tasks to the tracker now.

Rafael: noted, I'll follow up with AstraHealth with the brief and offer a deeper review if they'd like.

CI-Deploy: Deploy logs attached: https://ci.redwood/jobs/rb-198234/logs

Mike: closing note: if anyone sees any residual streaming stalls, ping me directly.

Devon: thanks team — good mitigation. :thumbsup:
